baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of belief, intended action, repaired action, inward good, and return.
baseline_models.mechanism: Trusted inner security issues in deliberate repair; repair ripens into willing inward ease and an attractive homecoming.

activation_trace.role: Security and trusted stillness make belief the mechanism's settled starting condition.
Purposive action carries inner security into an intended deed.
Repair against corruption specifies what the intended deed accomplishes.
The soul's willing ease makes the good an uncoerced inward state, not merely an award.
Desired beauty qualifies the return as experientially attractive.
Return to a gathering place closes the causal arc as homecoming.

changed_reading.before: A formula promising reward after belief and good deeds.
changed_reading.after: A causal arc in which trusted repose becomes deliberate repair and culminates in a freely welcomed homecoming.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural repaired acts and the beneficiaries marked by 'for them'.
baseline_models.mechanism: Deliberate dealings remove estrangement and restore fit between people; the result is a return to a relation one can inhabit without coercion.

activation_trace.role: Human transaction supplies the social field in which the deeds operate.
Removing interpersonal estrangement makes reconciliation the deeds' function.
Suitability adds restored fit rather than generic moral approval.
Unforced satisfaction marks the repaired relation as willingly inhabitable.
Gathering back into a place renders the outcome a social homecoming.

changed_reading.before: Private merit accumulated by separate individuals.
changed_reading.after: Relational labor that restores fit and lets a plural community return to an inhabitable bond.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coupling of work with return permits an embodied route model.
baseline_models.mechanism: Working limbs traverse a worked road, while their repeated motion already rehearses the return named at the end; destination and recurrent reorientation coexist.

activation_trace.role: Working limbs give the deed an embodied carrier.
A worked, traversed road turns action into an itinerary.
Travelers proceeding on foot keep the itinerary materially enacted.
The limbs' recurrent return in travel makes homecoming a repeated motion as well as an endpoint.
Arrival from multiple directions keeps more than one route into the return open.
Utmost exertion qualifies the route as sustained effort rather than passive transport.

changed_reading.before: A static destination reached only after deeds are complete.
changed_reading.after: Each embodied stride can rehearse return, while the final homecoming remains the beautiful completion of the route.

context_deltas.mechanism: Running on an established course toward an appointed limit, under management that considers outcomes, recasts return as a governed trajectory that reaches an encounter.

activation_trace.role: Homeward return supplies the focus endpoint to be dynamically revised.
An established running course supplies ordered motion toward the endpoint.
An appointed temporal limit gives the course a bounded arrival.
Management by considering the consequence links present motion to its end.
The meeting of two counterparts renders arrival an encounter, not mere stoppage.

structural_cues: 13:2 orders course, appointed term, outcome-aware management, and encounter in one progression.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies course, limit, consequence, and meeting; I map that progression onto the focus return. The live alternative is that it only grounds certainty about cosmic order.

changed_reading.before: Return as an abrupt terminal reward.
changed_reading.after: Return as the meeting reached by a governed course whose present movement already faces its appointed outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: Neighboring growths from shared origins receive one irrigation yet issue distinct yields; repaired acts become situated cultivation whose goodness is tested by fitting, nourishing fruit.

activation_trace.role: Intended work anchors cultivation back in the focus deeds.
Fitness makes goodness responsive to the plot rather than mechanically uniform.
Wholesome, desirable quality names the kind of yield that counts as good.
Neighboring proximity creates comparable but distinct sites of growth.
Cultivation and growth supply the productive process assigned to action.
Shoots issuing from one root hold origin constant while outcomes vary.
Irrigation supplies the common enabling input.
Unity in one direction keeps the water-source condition shared.
Agricultural yield provides the observable test of cultivated fitness.

structural_cues: 13:4 holds adjacency and water constant while distinguishing edible outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies common input, distinct plots, and differentiated yield; I treat deeds as the cultivation that mediates input into fruit. Alternatively, the ecology may illustrate signs without defining action.

changed_reading.before: Righteous acts as a uniform checklist.
changed_reading.after: Righteous acts as context-sensitive cultivation: shared provision becomes diverse but fitting and nourishing yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured flow separates buoyant display from useful residue that remains in fertile ground; repair is tested by durable benefit rather than surface volume.

activation_trace.role: Repair against corruption anchors the assay in the focus acts.
Wholesome quality names the retained result rather than its showy surface.
Fitting a thing to its measure makes the assay proportional to each channel.
Floating foam supplies conspicuous but nonretained output.
Benefit opposed to harm defines the material that passes the assay.
Stable remaining with waiting makes durability part of goodness.
Fertile ground is the receiving medium in which retained benefit can continue working.

structural_cues: 13:17 explicitly stages flow, surface separation, disappearance, and useful remainder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a material separation of foam from lasting benefit; I apply that assay to the focus deeds. The live alternative confines the image to truth and falsehood in discourse.

changed_reading.before: Any visibly good performance qualifies as a righteous deed.
changed_reading.after: A deed qualifies by the useful residue it leaves after display falls away, especially what remains productive in its receiving ground.

context_deltas.mechanism: Haste advances the bad before the good, while patient good later functions as a counterforce against bad; the beautiful return is produced through reversal, not simple accumulation.

activation_trace.role: Repair against corruption anchors reversal as a function of the focus deeds.
Hasty advancement supplies the temporal disorder in which bad is demanded first.
Ugliness and badness name the force that repair must reverse.
Doing good supplies the opposed constructive force.
Holding the self against panic supplies the delay required for constructive reversal.
Beneficent action becomes the active means rather than a decorative quality.
Badness is the affected object, keeping the mechanism corrective.

structural_cues: 13:6 places the bad before the good under haste.
The branchless root د ر ء at 13:22 word 13 is used only as the structural cue that good acts upon bad.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reversed ordering, patience, and good acting against bad; I infer that this corrective arrow specifies how focus repair produces a good return. Alternatively, the two contrasts need not describe one process.

changed_reading.before: Good deeds add positive credit beside existing harm.
changed_reading.after: Patient good is counteractive repair: it meets bad, reverses its trajectory, and thereby changes what can return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Preserved covenant and sustained connection become reconciliatory repair; entry spreads across kin and gates and terminates in peace, making the return an inhabited social topology.

activation_trace.role: Return to a gathering place anchors the contextual household sequence in the focus.
Preservation over successive occasions makes relation-maintenance an enduring practice.
Sustaining connection and refusing estrangement supplies the social action.
Reconciliation extends the focus repair directly into the admitted household.
Entry into an interior turns outcome into shared inhabitation.
Multiple entrances spatialize converging access to the shared home.
Peace after conflict names the relational condition reached inside.
The end or consequence links maintained connection to the resulting abode.

structural_cues: 13:20-24 moves from covenant and connection through repaired kin, repeated entry, greeting, and consequence.
The repeated plural beneficiaries in the focus remain compatible with a communal rather than solitary return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies maintained bonds, repaired kin, gates, peace, and consequence; I read them as the topology produced by focus repair. The alternative is that they describe reward without specifying the deeds' social mechanism.

changed_reading.after: A communal homecoming built by maintained bonds, where repaired relations across generations can enter and dwell in peace.

context_deltas.mechanism: Belief is immediately coupled to a twice-stated settling of hearts through recollection; this activates the focus good as inward consent and spacious repose, not only external fortune.

activation_trace.role: The soul's willing ease anchors the affective reading in the focus good.
Trusted security repeats the focus's settled condition one verse earlier.
Repeated stillness and reassurance make settling the immediate experiential effect.
The heart locates that settling within the person rather than in external possessions.
Repeated recollection supplies the activity through which inward repose is renewed.

structural_cues: 13:28 repeats the recollection-settling relation on both sides of an attention marker immediately before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies belief, doubled heart-settling, and recollection; proximity and the focus pleasantness support carrying that affect forward. The alternative is that 13:28 merely identifies the people later promised an external good.

changed_reading.before: The focus good is only a future possession assigned to believers.
changed_reading.after: The good also names a present, uncoerced inward spaciousness repeatedly renewed in the believing heart.

context_deltas.mechanism: Habitual return, repeated return to a direction, heart-turning, directed aim, reliance, and a later lexical return converge: the final homecoming is enacted through recurring reorientation.

activation_trace.role: Recurrent bodily return lets the focus endpoint include repeated reorientation.
Habitual return supplies recurrence rather than a single turn.
Repeated return to a place or direction sharpens recurrence as orientation.
Movement from place to place preserves the split root's mobile alternative within the return model.
Turning and destination connect the heart's changes of direction to its eventual issue.
Aim and directed movement give repeated turning a stable vector.
Reliant entrustment sustains the orientation when the endpoint is not yet reached.
The later direct return echo confirms homeward gathering as a recurring surah-level endpoint.

structural_cues: 13:27-30 sequences one who returns, settling hearts, the focus homecoming, directed trust, and a first-person return noun.
13:36 repeats the focus return root at its close.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three mapped return motions, heart-turning, aim, trust, and a later lexical echo; I infer that recurrence constitutes the path to final return. The alternative keeps recurring orientation and terminal homecoming separate.

changed_reading.before: One irreversible transfer to a final destination.
changed_reading.after: A final homecoming whose form is practiced now as repeated turning, re-aiming, and entrusted return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Continuous flow feeds lasting edible yield under protective shade, and the scene names itself as consequence; the focus good return becomes a regenerative habitat rather than a consumable prize.

activation_trace.role: Wholesome desirability anchors the habitat's nourishing quality in the focus.
Homeward gathering lets the environmental scene specify what kind of return is good.
Ongoing flow supplies the habitat's renewing circulation.
Plant yield makes the return materially nourishing rather than merely scenic.
Still continuity makes the yield enduring rather than briefly consumed.
Sheltering protection makes the destination an inhabitable refuge.
Named consequence explicitly links this durable habitat to the outcome of a path.

structural_cues: 13:35 binds flowing water, continuing food, shade, and doubled consequence in one habitat image.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies regenerative resources and explicitly names consequence; I use them to thicken the focus return into a habitat. The alternative treats each item only as a destination's amenities.

changed_reading.before: A pleasant reward object received at the end.
changed_reading.after: An enduring ecology of flow, nourishment, and shelter into which one returns and within which goodness keeps renewing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats return as revision of an action-trace rather than travel. It remains anchored in intended work and homeward return, while 13:39 supplies erasure, fixation, and inscription; downstream prose should label the editorial arrow speculative and avoid making a doctrine of mutable accounting.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Intended work followed by return permits asking what trace of the work returns.

activation_trace.role: Purposive action supplies the trace whose persistence is at issue.
Homeward return anchors revision to the focus outcome.
Removal of an effect supplies the subtractive operation on the trace.
Durable fixation supplies the contrasting operation that preserves a remainder.
An inscription that establishes consequence provides the medium in which erasure and fixation matter.

changed_reading.before: Every deed travels unchanged into a fixed return.
changed_reading.after: Return may expose an edited action-trace: some effects disappear, while what has been made firm becomes the durable remainder that comes home.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This spatial reading is odd because it converts territorial edge-loss into inward homecoming. It remains anchored in the focus branch of return from directions and in 13:41's arrival, subtraction, and edges; downstream prose should present it only as an image of relinquished peripheral attachments, not as the verse's settled referent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Return from every direction can be imagined against a field whose outer edges contract.

activation_trace.role: Coming from multiple directions supplies the focus's spatial anchor.
Arrival supplies centripetal movement into the spatial image.
Loss of part supplies progressive subtraction from the field.
The outer edge locates what is being stripped away during return.

changed_reading.before: Return adds arrival at a distant place.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, homecoming can also subtract the periphery: outer attachments contract until the returning center becomes visible.

strongest_changes: Good acts became durable-benefit assays rather than visible performances.
Goodness became counteractive repair that patiently reverses bad.
Return became both a communal household topology and a repeatedly enacted orientation.
The promised good acquired a present inward mode and a perennial ecological mode without collapsing either into the other.
summary.what_was_special: The terse focus supports several nonexclusive mechanisms: secure intention becoming repair, cultivation yielding fit nourishment, relational bonds becoming a peaceful home, and recurrent turning becoming final homecoming. Material and spatial branches preserved readings that a reward-only paraphrase would lose.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the ecological and material images define righteous action or only analogically illuminate it.
Whether inward settledness is itself part of the focus good or only precedes a future good.
How far recurrent return may be carried into the terminal sense of homecoming without flattening their difference.
The erasure and edge-contraction outliers remain deliberately speculative.
